picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic partnership with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions is a landmark fusion of frontier AI and fundamental physics, with potential to reshape how discovery-scale science is done.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, links national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a coordinated AI-for-science infrastructure, a major federal bet on accelerating discovery.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced, 14-plus-university Southeast Regional Computing Consortium signals a coordinated regional push to build shared advanced-computing infrastructure for AI research, with Vanderbilt among the founding members.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $20M NSF-backed robot-controlled AI cloud lab (AURORA) at Arkansas could dramatically speed the discovery of new quantum materials by automating experimentation at scale.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: ACL's Test of Time Award to Rico Sennrich for subword tokenization (BPE) recognizes a decade-old technique that quietly became foundational infrastructure underpinning how virtually all modern large language models process text.
picks.title: A Smart Computer

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model predicts protein motion dramatically faster than traditional molecular dynamics simulations, opening the door to studying biomolecular behavior at scales previously computationally out of reach.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's work probing internal LLM activity for early warning signs of unsafe or misaligned behavior directly addresses a core AI-safety concern raised by real incidents, making it relevant to emerging AI oversight policy.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to study light propagation through complex environments represents a substantial federal investment in optical sensing and computational imaging research.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: A $1.6 million Google.org grant lets UCT build an AI platform mapping genetic variants affecting drug metabolism in African patients, a concrete step toward more equitable, population-specific precision medicine.
picks.title: Google grant boosts UCT's AI-driven scientific breakthroughs

picks.editorial_note: NJIT spinout OppyAI is commercializing 'Neural Crypto,' a hybrid AI approach letting organizations use cloud-scale AI while keeping prompts and data private, a novel answer to enterprise AI privacy concerns.
picks.title: NJIT Spinout OppyAI Takes Private Hybrid AI to the Global Stage
